action: Inspected AllPSMs.psmtsv header and mzML file sizes; confirmed two K562 runs (_3, _4), PSM table has File Name, Scan RT, Precursor MZ/Charge/Mass, Full Sequence, Protein Accession, QValue columns
note: PSM table is rich; MBR quant will need MS1 XIC extraction from the two mzML files

action: Web search: R package for label-free quant with MBR from PSM table + mzML
note: No R package does LFQ+MBR end-to-end. The MBR engines are standalone (IonQuant, FragPipe, MaxQuant, FlashLFQ). In R, MSnbase/mzR only READ raw data; they do not quantify.

action: Web search: does MSstats extract features / do MBR
note: MSstats does statistics on an ALREADY-extracted feature table (needs ProteinName/Peptide/Charge/FragmentIon/Intensity/Run). It does NOT read mzML and does NOT do match-between-runs. So even if installed it cannot answer these questions from raw runs.

action: Checked for C/C++ toolchain (make/gcc) needed to build mzR/MSnbase/xcms from source
note: No make, no gcc. Bioconductor raw-reading packages have compiled code; cannot build here. Confirms the intended tools are unavailable.

action: install.packages('RaMS') from CRAN (pure-R mzML reader, binary install)
note: RaMS + data.table + base64enc installed as Windows binaries. RaMS can READ mzML MS1/MS2, but does NO quantification, peak integration, or MBR. I would have to hand-build the entire LFQ+MBR engine on top of it.

action: Loaded AllPSMs.psmtsv with data.table, filtered to confident target IDs (Decoy/Contaminant/Target=='T' & QValue<=0.01), split by run
note: 576 PSMs. Unique modified peptides: run3=264, run4=215, in-both=127, run3-only=137, run4-only=88. 299 unique Protein Accession strings. This is IDENTIFICATION, not quantification.

action: RaMS::grabMzmlData read MS1 from both mzML; built crude XIC (per-scan summed intensity within 10 ppm, RT window), calibrated on known peptides
note: Files are RT slices (73 MS1 scans, 79-83 min, same window in both runs). Real peptides give clean apices, random m/z gives 0. Both runs cover same RT so RT alignment is ~1:1 for this dataset.

action: Hand-built quant of every IDed peptide in its own run (apex at ID m/z & RT)
note: 263/264 run3 and 215/215 run4 IDed peptides have clear own-run signal. Direct own-run quant is reliable.

action: Hand-built naive MBR: looked up run3-only peptides in run4 (and vice versa) at donor m/z+RT; ADDED a decoy-m/z control (m/z shifted +0.5 Th) as a poor-man's MBR FDR
note: FATAL for MBR: decoy m/z gives almost as many hits as true m/z (target 109 vs decoy 74 at thr 5e4; 180 vs 157 at any-signal). ~60-90% false-match rate. In dense MS1, a 10ppm+0.5min window almost always contains SOMETHING. Without isotope-envelope + peak-shape + FDR (which RaMS lacks and FlashLFQ/IonQuant provide), I cannot count true rescues. Q2 not answerable.

action: Computed MBR-free trustworthy Q1 and Q3 across thresholds (0, 5e4, 1e5)
note: Q1 direct-quant-in-both = 127/121/111 (stable ~121-127). Q3 protein groups with no usable intensity = 1/2/19 (stable at low thr, blows up at high thr). Q3 uses naive accession-string grouping, no parsimony.
